title: 第十一章 网络幽灵第十二章 计算机之神和投资之神
content_zh:
林夜给自己戴上了口罩，让自己尽可能看起来平淡一些，他不想太过引人注目。
“迄今为止，我已经看见了两个古武者，一个是秦舒婉，另一个就是今天那个查案的男人，这说明在灵气复苏之前，应该就存在古武者，甚至有可能存在专门针对古武以及进化者的部门。
联邦隐藏了许多普通人未知的隐秘。
另外，黄海的出现标志着进化者可能就在身边，但联邦显然没有打算在短时间之内公布的意思，这对我而言是一个很危险的事情。
再一个，我的股票不能一直赚钱，否则就会被联邦金融监管注意到，我还需要想办法获取更多的珍贵药材...”
这一切，都需要信息。
没有信息，人就如封闭了五官六识，身处一片黑暗，像个瞎子一样。
那么接下来，应该要学习电子信息技术了。
林夜来到图书馆，这一次，他开始学习电子信息、电脑编程技术一系列相关知识。
《程序设计》、《计算机编程基础》、《c语言程序设计》、《python编程从入门到实践》...
...
五天之后，林夜合上最后一本书，嘴角微微扬起。
“现在的我，应该可以算是一个顶级黑客了。”
有了这个技术，他就等于长了一双千里眼，一双顺风耳，更是可以化身幽灵，游走于万里开外的网络之中，不被任何人发现。
看了一下脑力经验，五天时间，自己一共获取了六十四点经验值，这又是另外一个惊喜。
“先去了解一下这个世界的秘密吧。”
林夜起身离开了图书馆，来到学校附近的网咖。
刚上大学的时候，他和张郃以及其他几个同学为了玩吃鸡，还专门办了会员卡，后来玩腻了，卡里剩的几百块一直没来玩。
林夜都快忘了这件事，内心基本已经认同把这几百块打水漂了，没想到竟然还有再利用的这一天。
他找了一个单独的包厢，打开机器，开始启动编程。

“先打造一个虚假的ip地址...不，先打造一百个虚拟ip地址。”
网吧的ip地址是固定的，自己还是用身份证上网，不先打造一些虚假地址，别人顺着网线轻松就能找到自己。
等打造出足够多的虚假ip之后，林夜这才开始尝试着黑进一些网页。
他没有上来就挑战那些顶级存在，譬如联邦一些重要部门，他选择先是从一些小公司开始试试水。
还别说，以他现在的实力，破解这些小公司的网页就好像是拿着钥匙捅开锁一样简单，轻轻松松就能破解进去。
不过基本没什么太大价值，小公司的网络无非就是一些生意往来。
在简单尝试了一下自己的实力之后，林夜开始尝试进入更高级别的公司，譬如一些国内的知名大厂。
他就像是一个幽灵，悄无声息地进入其中。
大公司的网络安全管理相对要强太多，但这在林夜面前都不是大问题，强大的脑力计算，加上丰富的程序知识可以让他在短时间之内快速反应，并完成全新进化。
进入之后，林夜发现自己赫然进入了一个全新天地。
别的不说，光是那一笔笔生意往来就足够刺激得让人心口砰砰直跳，动辄数亿乃至数十亿的交易，这是无数人一辈子都见不到的秘密。
而现在，他不仅可以看到，甚至还能悄悄动手修改掉一些资料。
这让他忽然间想到了小时候的梦想，那个时候他就想做一个黑客，然后自己给自己修改q币，修改装备，修改皮肤...
可惜时光一去不复返，如今有了这种能力，也懒得去做了。
“咦，这是...”
林夜正饶有兴致查看的时候，忽然间在某个东夏联邦深城龙头企业的机密文件中，发现了一些特殊加密资料。
在精心破解一番之后，他点开文件夹，里面赫然是一些机密文档和一些影像视频。
林夜点开视频文件，第一段视频是在一处深山老林中，一队全副武装的雇佣兵，正在狩猎一条狼。
准确的来说，是一条巨狼！
它的身高超过两米，长度超过四米，巨大的口腔能一口咬爆一个成年人的脑袋。
content_en:
Lin Ye put on a mask to make himself look as plain as possible. He didn't want to attract too much attention.
"So far, I have seen two ancient warriors, one is Qin Shuwan, and the other is the man who investigated the case today. This shows that before the spiritual energy is revived, there should be ancient warriors, and there may even be a department specifically targeting ancient warriors and evolvers.
The Federation hides many secrets unknown to ordinary people.
In addition, the emergence of the Yellow Sea indicates that the Evolved One may be around, but the Federation obviously has no intention of announcing it in a short time. This is a very dangerous thing to me.
Another thing is that my stocks cannot keep making money, otherwise they will be noticed by federal financial supervision. I also need to find ways to obtain more precious medicinal materials..."
All of this requires information.
Without information, people are like having their five senses and six senses closed, and are in darkness, like a blind man.
Then next, you should learn electronic information technology.
Lin Ye came to the library. This time, he began to learn a series of related knowledge about electronic information and computer programming technology.
"Programming", "Basics of Computer Programming", "C Language Programming", "Python Programming from Introduction to Practice"...
...
Five days later, Lin Ye closed the last book and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
"I should be considered a top hacker now."
With this technology, he is equivalent to having a pair of clairvoyance and a pair of ears, and he can turn into a ghost and wander around the Internet thousands of miles away without being discovered by anyone.
After looking at the mental experience, I found that I had gained a total of sixty-four experience points in five days, which was another surprise.
"Let's learn the secrets of this world first."
Lin Ye got up and left the library and went to an Internet cafe near the school.
When he first entered college, he, Zhang He and several other classmates got special membership cards to play chicken. Later, they got tired of playing and never used the few hundred yuan left in the card to play.
Lin Ye almost forgot about this matter. He basically agreed in his heart that these hundreds of dollars were wasted. He didn't expect that there would be a day when he could use it again.
He found a separate box, turned on the machine, and started programming.
"Create a fake IP address first... No, create a hundred virtual IP addresses first."
The IP address of the Internet cafe is fixed. You should use your ID card to access the Internet. Without creating some false addresses first, others can easily find you by following the network cable.
After creating enough fake IPs, Lin Ye began to try to hack into some web pages.
He did not challenge those top entities, such as some important federal departments. He chose to start with some small companies to test the waters.
Not to mention, with his current strength, cracking the web pages of these small companies is as easy as holding a key to a lock, and he can crack it easily.
But it's basically not of much value. The network of a small company is nothing more than some business transactions.
After briefly testing his own strength, Lin Ye began to try to enter higher-level companies, such as some well-known domestic manufacturers.
He was like a ghost, entering silently.
The network security management of large companies is relatively much stronger, but this is not a big problem in front of Lin Ye. Powerful mental calculations and rich programming knowledge allow him to react quickly and complete a new evolution in a short time.
After entering, Lin Ye found that he had suddenly entered a new world.
Not to mention anything else, the business transactions alone are enough to make people's hearts beat with excitement. Transactions of hundreds of millions or even billions are frequent. This is a secret that countless people will never see in their lifetime.
But now, not only can he see it, he can even quietly modify some information.
This suddenly reminded him of his childhoodAt that time, he wanted to be a hacker, and then modify his own Q coins, equipment, and skins...
It's a pity that time has gone forever, and now that I have this ability, I am too lazy to do it.
"Hey, this is..."
When Lin Ye was checking it with great interest, he suddenly found some special encrypted information in the confidential documents of a leading enterprise in the Eastern Xia Federation Deep City.
After carefully cracking it, he clicked on the folder, which contained some confidential documents and some images and videos.
Lin Ye clicked on the video file. The first video was of a group of heavily armed mercenaries hunting a wolf in a deep mountain forest.
To be precise, a giant wolf!
It is more than two meters tall and four meters long, and its huge mouth can bite an adult's head in one bite.
